summary: Long-poll fallback closes early, truncating streamed tail on reconnect
description:
Issue summary: Customer reports that when their corporate edge rewrites Streaming SSE to a long-poll fallback path, the last ~1-2 sentences of responses are consistently missing after a reconnect.

Impact: Intermittent data loss for streaming responses behind certain proxies; affects customer-facing assistant content (missing trailing sentences). Reported by a Dedicated customer (NimbusDocs) using the hosted API through a corporate proxy that downgrades SSE to HTTP long-polling.

Observed behavior: Client receives streamed tokens, then connection is torn down by edge for long-poll fallback. When the session resumes the service returns an early 204/OK and the final trailer event (closing marker/end metadata) is not delivered to the client. Result: truncated final paragraph and absent terminal metadata (choice.finish_reason).

Expected behavior: Fallback path should replay or proxy through the complete trailing chunks or the server should re-emit terminal events after reconstitution so the client receives the full final sentence and closing metadata.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Customer environment: desktop app behind corporate proxy that strips SSE and does long-polling; use proxy that rewrites HTTP/1.1 to HTTP/1.0 and closes keepalive after 15s.
2) Open a streaming chat session against the Redwood hosted API with Accept: text/event-stream and keepalive enabled; send a prompt that yields a 60-120 token final paragraph.
3) Trigger a controlled network interruption to force the proxy to close and re-establish the HTTP connection (simulate edge path change or probe).
4) Observe on the client: streaming resumes but final 1-2 sentences are missing; server logs show a short-lived long-poll request that returns without the closing trailer event.
5) Reproduce reliably by toggling the proxy keepalive interval in synthetic lab; behavior observed ~7/10 runs.
logs: [2026-03-10T14:08:26Z] client -> proxy: Connection close by proxy (keepalive expiry) (15s)
[2026-03-10T14:08:26Z] proxy -> rt-proxy: new long-poll /v1/stream?session=abc returning 200 OK (early-close)
[2026-03-10T14:08:26Z] rt-proxy: stream-session abc resumed; last-kv-checkpoint=0x7f1; trailer_flag=false
[2026-03-10T14:08:27Z] serving-runtime: produced final-choice tokens, emitted trailer meta (choice.finish_reason=length)
[2026-03-10T14:08:27Z] rt-proxy: upstream write failed: client closed connection; skipping trailer emission on long-poll path
investigation_notes: Hypothesis 1: Long-poll fallback path short-circuits trailer emission when client socket indicates close; race between runtime's trailer write and proxy long-poll response commit.

Hypothesis 2: Proxy/edge performs an extra connection-level close that causes rt-proxy to treat resumed session as ephemeral and drop final metadata to avoid blocking write (backpressure handling path).
Repro steps validated in internal staging with our test proxy (haproxy) reproducing 80% of runs when keepalive <= 20s.

Observed difference vs normal SSE: SSE code path uses chunked transfer with streaming flush; long-poll path uses buffered response commit and currently lacks explicit trailer re-synthesis when the client reconnection occurs.
Logs indicate serving-runtime did emit finish trailer but rt-proxy logged upstream write failure before it could sink to the client long-poll response body.
comments: Amelia Chen (Support) 2026-03-10: Acknowledged ticket to customer, requested example session IDs and sample network captures. First response within SLA.

NimbusDocs (Customer) 2026-03-10: Provided tcpdump + proxy logs and one failing session id (abc). They confirm this happens behind their Palo Alto NGFW which downgrades SSE to polling for legacy clients.

Diego Morales (SRE) 2026-03-11: Reproduced locally using haproxy rewrite script. Confirmed trailer emission race. Created scoped patch to add server-side retry to ensure trailers are replayed on resumed long-poll responses (branch: fix/long-poll-trailer-replay).
Product (Benita Arora) 2026-03-11: Asked for risk assessment and whether this impacts other fallback paths (ws->long-poll, http2->http1).

Diego Morales (SRE) 2026-03-12: Hotfix staged in canary (us-east staging). Observed full trailer delivery in 95/100 synthetic runs. Plan: backport hotfix to production proxy layer and release rollout with feature flag to disable fallback replay as kill-switch.
NimbusDocs (Customer) 2026-03-12: Requested ETA for production fix and whether there is a short-term client workaround.
Support (Amelia) 2026-03-12: Provided customer workaround: enable direct SSE passthrough for Redwood endpoints or increase proxy keepalive to >= 60s; both mitigate until patch is rolled out.
resolution: Workaround provided to customer (enable SSE passthrough or increase proxy keepalive). Hotfix implemented in rt-proxy to replay trailers on long-poll resume (branch fix/long-poll-trailer-replay). Canary results positive; production rollout scheduled with a config flag and canary wedge. Postmortem and formal remediation tracked on confluence page. Follow-up: add integration test for long-poll fallback path and update runbooks to include proxy keepalive guidance.
resolution_notes: Canary deployed to us-east staging 2026-03-12 08:30Z; 95% success in synthetic tests.
Prod rollout planned 2026-03-13 with feature-flagged rollouts per region.
Post-deploy: monitor streaming error rates and truncated-response alerts for 48h; add automated regression test in CI.
